segments.text: This is the Unstable SMP, the world's largest Minecraft server.

But, with every player only having one life, there's also danger lurking around every corner.
You see, with this many players constantly online the server, there's not enough resources to go around, leading to a server-wide famine.
The current king of the server, Sapperata, has promised to fix the famine.
